summary: Hand-authored the eight CDC tables, including a tri-state coverage CHECK and deliberately NULLABLE capital columns.
reason: Coverage has to distinguish three genuinely different states that a boolean cannot express: found, not-found-at-source (asked, and the source really has nothing), and not-probed (never asked). Collapsing the last two is what makes a coverage map lie about completeness, so the state is a CHECK-constrained column with transport-error as a fourth, explicitly separate value. cdc_penetration_rows keeps capital and percentage NULLABLE because the funds part of the report genuinely has no capital column -- storing 0 there would be fabricating an observation, and a missing observation recorded as missing is the correct outcome.
validated_outcome: 1,217 coverage buckets carry all four states; 29,966 penetration rows load with NULL capital preserved for part-B funds rather than zero-filled.
